audit_correction_rationale: Peak river discharge of 1250.0 cumec stripped from observation field because no Musi stream-gauge telemetry existed in 2000; preserved in audit trail as unsupported estimate.

provenance_evidence_note: Peak discharge of ~480 m³/s (~17,000 cusecs) represents calculated reservoir gate outflow into Musi, NOT an open-channel stream-gauge measurement. Sourced agency was AP Irrigation Department (pre-Telangana bifurcation). Cited DES URL only contains annual totals.
provenance_unresolved_issues: Cited DES URL is a general department portal; 2008 daily gate logs are archived in physical state department ledgers.
audit_correction_rationale: Downgraded confidence from HIGH to LOW; agency corrected to AP Irrigation Department; discharge reclassified as dam outflow estimate rather than stream observation.

source_agency: GHMC Disaster Management / TSDPS Weather Bulletin (Sep 2016)
geographic_uncertainty: Northern urban lakes and chain nalas; municipal boundary Medchal/GHMC.
provenance_source_title: TSDPS Daily Rainfall Bulletin (September 2016) & GHMC Disaster Assessment
provenance_publisher: Telangana State Development Planning Society & GHMC
provenance_citation_detail: TSDPS Hakimpet AFS rainfall of 165.4 mm; Nizampet municipal flood damage logs.
provenance_evidence_note: Rainfall observed via TSDPS AWS at Hakimpet. Flooding occurred in Nizampet lake basins (Alwal and Fox Sagar nalas). audit_correction_rationale: Stripped unsupported 210 cumec river discharge. Flooding was caused by lake surplus nalas in Nizampet, not Musi River overflow.
